Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane and began a left turn at an intersection in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle was
struck on the driver side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through. Driver 2 stated that the collision happened
as described, and two independent witnesses gave consistent accounts of the impact. Photographs taken at the
scene show damage to both vehicles that matches the described collision, and I found no indication of prior damage
to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 later reported a concussion. However, both witnesses and I observed that Driver 1 was
not isnide the vehicle at the moment of the crash, so the reported position of Driver 1 requires follow-up. Whether the
reported injury resulted from this clolision is not yet established. A Passenger was not identified at the scene. Driver 1
is listed as a named insured on the policy associated with the vehicle. Further statements and medical information will
be requested before any conclusions are drawn.
